scenes.headline: How to check a gated model without opening it
scenes.sub: An abliterated GLM-5.3-Flash, read from Hugging Face's own metadata.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Quark! This release's README is locked behind a gate. Here's what its public metadata still proves, and what it can't.

scenes.text: The README is gated, but Hub metadata shows every tensor count and type identical to the base: the edit changed values, not structure.
scenes.say: The idea: even locked, the repo's metadata shows every tensor count and type identical to the base model. The edit changed values, not structure.

left.title: Suppress the direction
items: Across a range of open chat models
left.say: Published research found refusal in many open models runs along one direction in their activations. Suppress it, and they mostly stop refusing.

right.title: Add the direction
items: A poem about a cat, refused
right.say: Add it, and they refuse even a poem about a cat. Working both ways is what makes it mediation.

steps.note: the README returns 401 on every fetch
steps.say: The README is gated. But Hugging Face's model API still describes the repo, with no login.
Parameters by type: about three hundred fourteen billion in FP8, nearly seven billion in BF16. The base model's counts are identical, to the parameter.
Same config size, and the same list of unconverted tensors, in the same order. Only the README differs.
So no adapter was added and nothing was reshaped. Only weight values changed, inside the same tensors.

scenes.label: Headline rows, and what they measure
scenes.note: all five self-reported, with no stated harness or judge
scenes.say: Five headline numbers. Four measure how much refusal was removed, all self-reported. Only XSTest, over-refusal on harmless prompts, is an ordinary quality metric.

scenes.label: refusal left across four suites; most models in the paper fall under 8%
scenes.note: a partial edit, or not one direction: public data can't tell
scenes.say: The refusal left over runs eleven to eighteen percent, where most models in the paper fall under eight. A partial edit, or more than one direction? Nothing public decides.

scenes.text: Public metadata can prove an edit changed values, not structure. What it did to behaviour still rests on self-report.

recap: Refusal runs along one published direction
The repo matches its base, tensor for tensor
Four of five headline rows measure removal
scenes.say: To recap: a published one-direction finding, a repo that matches its base exactly, and results that are self-reported.
